title: Cleansing Duty
description: The Priest of Morthane does not send you out for these because any one skeleton matters. He sends you because the cycle is not defended once and left defended - it is a duty kept or it is not kept at all, and he intends to keep asking for as long as the dead keep getting back up.

objectives.description: Destroy undead creatures corrupting the cycle

notes: System, not a plot - no invented threat. Giver motive: doctrine treats the fight as permanent, not a problem with an ending, consistent with the priest's voice elsewhere in the line.
